'''August 2000 San Diego tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in San Diego, California on 5 August 2000. [[Tyler Alexander]] won it. It is known from Tyler Alexander's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1086">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-05-san-diego-california-8-5-00d1086/ san-diego-california-8-5-00], DeckTech (Tyler ""_WRAITH_"" Alexander, 5 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-05-san-diego-california-8-5-00d1086/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 August 2000
* '''Site:''' San Diego, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Tyler Alexander]]
